Match Point: prototype

Head-to-Head & Player Analytics, Built on Real ATP Match History.

Data loads and runs entirely in your browser. Nothing is sent anywhere.

        Pick a player to see current ranking, season record, surface splits, and recent form.

        Match data: Jeff Sackmann's ATP and WTA results archives (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, attribution required, non-commercial use), tour-level singles 1968–2026, via the Aneeshers/tennis-sackmann-archive repository. Current ranks are the archive's latest snapshot (). Match dates are tournament start dates. Statistics are calculated from the match rows in the dataset; nothing is invented, and missing values are shown as unavailable. The hypothetical matchup feature is a simplified illustrative estimate based on real stats, not a professional forecasting or betting probability. Live scores, current-week rankings, and in-progress tournaments are not covered by this historical dataset.
